name: query_agent
description: Dispatch the user's verbatim finalized utterance to Vektral. The host POSTs /api/vocalbridge/query and then speaks only agent_response. Do not mutate panes, invent pane ids, or call spatial_command.

text.description: Verbatim user intent for this turn. Do not paraphrase.

turn_id.description: Stable id for this finalized utterance, 8 to 80 characters. Reuse the host id when one was already assigned.
